steps.text: Mash half the beans with a fork, then stir in the garlic, olive oil, and lemon juice.
Toast the sourdough until golden at the edges.
Spoon the beans over the toast.
Top with the remaining whole beans, parsley, salt, pepper, and a thread of olive oil.
